title: Write a CPlusPlus CHOP
summary: Official Derivative guide for CPlusPlus CHOP authoring, covering custom CHOP input/output, getOutputInfo()-driven channel metadata, non-time-sliced startup behavior, and time-slice sample-count expectations.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs native CHOP data generation, external-source CHOP input/output, or plugin-side sample-rate semantics.
For simple startup, prefer non-time-sliced output where the plugin declares channel length and fills the same amount of data every frame.
A plugin can use an input CHOP to determine output channel count, channel names, sample rate, and related metadata, or specify them in getOutputInfo().
When outputting a Time Slice, the requested samples per channel depend on elapsed cook time, skipped frames, the CHOP sample rate, and the timeline rate.
Generated plans should not assume one sample per frame for time-sliced CPlusPlus CHOP output.
